units.summary: Advance the byte recurrence state = state*5+3 modulo 256. Increment once more when no gameplay button is held, making idle/input history affect later object choices.

units.summary: A is a zero-based case index. Pop the JSR return address into scratch_ptr; read a little-endian target from the table immediately after the call and jump without restoring that return address. Each target returns to the dispatcher caller.

units.name: FinishTimedBonus
units.summary: Erase the bonus countdown display, play the completion cue, update scores and leave through the common NMI epilogue.

units.name: TickBonusCountdown
units.summary: Update the bonus countdown every other frame. Convert it to packed decimal for the display, give periodic audio feedback, and continue updating the bonus sprites.

units.name: RunBonusFrame
units.summary: During a bonus/transition NMI, render the decimal bonus value and optional two-by-two icon, animate/count bonus awards, then leave through the common frame epilogue. phase_timer distinguishes animation steps.

units.name: AwardBonusStep
units.summary: Consume one remaining bonus item, add its score, refresh the decimal count and continue the NMI frame.

units.name: AdvanceBonusAnimation
units.summary: Advance the bonus animation step and run common end-of-frame work.

units.name: CompleteBonusAnimation
units.summary: Use $FF as the completion handshake observed by the foreground bonus loop.

units.name: CheckBonusIcons
units.summary: At steps $24 and $28, reveal award icons according to the collected bonus counter. The exact icon meaning is tentative.

units.name: NmiEntry
units.summary: Preserve A/X/Y, DMA the shadow OAM page $07, and select the shadowed CNROM CHR bank. mode_flags chooses title, bonus, paused or active-play work; all paths share the register restore/RTI.

units.name: RunActiveFrame
units.summary: Refresh the scrolling tile rows and HUD, establish a fixed top-of-screen scroll interval, restore gameplay scroll, then update gameplay unless paused or a special event owns the frame.

units.name: FinishFrame
units.summary: Refresh score tile shadows and sound, process Start/pause, rotate OAM ordering, increment the frame counter, then restore interrupted registers.

units.name: RestoreNmiRegisters
units.summary: Restore Y/X/A in reverse save order. IRQ points at the final RTI, so it does not consume an NMI register frame.

units.name: IrqReturn
units.summary: IRQ vector lands directly on RTI. No IRQ-specific service is established.

units.name: RunTitleFrame
units.summary: Update player-selection sprites/palette and live title input, then run sound before returning from NMI.

units.name: RunPausedFrame
units.summary: Keep polling input and refreshing score/pause sprites; retain the gameplay state until Start resumes.

units.name: RunEventFrame
units.summary: Dispatch masked event_flags: death breakup ($04), stage-clear delay ($08), warp sequence ($10), or the remaining vehicle collision/fall animation.

units.name: UpdateEventVehicles
units.summary: Update the four vehicle slots during an event frame without the normal spawn scheduler.

units.name: RunDeathEvent
units.summary: Advance the player breakup animation, then continue vehicle event updates.

units.name: TickStageClearDelay
units.summary: Count down the stage-clear delay. At zero, set the negative event flag that the foreground loop uses to leave the stage.

units.name: RunWarpEvent

regions.summary: Select a road stream using the course counter, folding later courses into an eight-entry repeating range. Two tile values precede alternating run counts; $FF ends either count phase. Expand into RAM starting at $0300. Convert the unsigned 16-bit scratch input by repeated subtraction of 10000,1000,100,10. The four low decimal digits are packed into decimal_low/decimal_high; the ten-thousands subtraction does not store a digit, so inputs are effectively reduced modulo 10000. A is an unsigned score increment (display units, with separate tile formatting). Suppress awards during attract mode, add to the selected 16-bit player score, check life thresholds, and update the high-score maximum. Clear both little-endian player scores and the temporary award amount; preserve the high score. Convert the active score, travel count and oil count into tile digits. Remove leading zeros within each field using blank tile $40. X is the destination field offset. Expand the two packed decimal bytes into four tile digits $30..$39, stored least significant first. X starts at the most significant field tile. Replace up to three leading zero tiles with blank tile $40, leaving at least one digit. Use two bits in life_award_flags to award one life after score >299 and another after >1000. Compare the active player score; award flags belong to the active player-state bank. Shift A right four places to extract its high nibble. Disable APU channels, clear the enable shadow and set all four stream cursors to the stopped sentinel $FF. Only update normal gameplay audio when attract_mode is zero. Title/event callers can enter the unconditional channel updater separately. Update four independent sound streams with X = channel index 0..3. channel_register_base is X*4 and selects APU register groups. Cursor 0 initializes stream headers; $FF stops. Otherwise count down duration, compute the two-byte event pointer, interpret control commands and play a note. Stream headers define mode, volume/control and sweep. Compute the 16-bit stream pointer = channel base + 2*cursor. Stream event records occupy two bytes. For mode $20 preserve the byte; other modes rotate the header bits into the high APU control positions. Entry carry participates in the rotate before masking. For pitched modes, the low nibble indexes a base timer word and the high nibble selects right shifts (octave). Noise mode accepts values below $10 directly. Values outside these ranges disable the channel but still advance its duration.
